Alexandra —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Monica is our implementation lead and Grace will be your ongoing CSM; looping them in to start the practical handoff. We put together a short "integration readiness" checklist and a few quick SDK snippets to speed up your sandbox cutover.

Quick asks / proposal:
- Monica to run a 60-minute implementation workshop with your eng team the week of Oct 20.
- Share current traffic profile (avg request/sec, burst pattern) so we can tailor batching and rate-limits.
- We'll provide node + python samples for: SDK init, retry/backoff wrapper, and graceful endpoint migration.

Attachments: redwood-integration-checklist-v1.pdf (checklist), sdk-examples-node-python.tar.gz (code samples).

Next steps: if Wednesday or Thursday morning PT works for your engs, Monica will send calendar invite and pre-read.

Best,

Subject: Re: Sandboxed integration handshake — SDK setup, timeouts, and rate safeguards

Thanks Ben — looping in Tom (platform engineer) with a couple of follow-ups so Monica has context before the workshop.

A few specific questions from Tom:
1) What are your recommended client-side timeout values for sync request patterns? We expect 200ms median, occasional 800ms tails.
2) How should we handle endpoint migration with minimal 5xx exposure — is a rolling DNS/weight-based cutover supported or do you recommend a staged traffic policy?
3) For rate limits, we operate behind our own gateway that enforces 1000 rps for the service range. We'd like a sample config to avoid hitting the Redwood host-side limiter during peak tests.

Tom will join the workshop; provisional slot Thu 10/22 09:30 PT.

—Alexandra
Director of Platform | Fletcher Labs
